title: GI school harmony and ear training
summary: In the service he attended GI school for harmony and ear training for about two and a half years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: As far as that instrument is concerned, I went to GI school for harmony. Oh yeah. And I took some ear training and stuff. I went to school about two years and a half.

Is that when Grunewald's head up on Camp Street or some place? I remember that. Quite a few fellows were up there, I remember. We were just about out of tape. Is there any other thing you'd like to add about your life story?
